advice.suggestion: City treasure hunts in which collecting a full set unlocks a bonus token
advice.words: It would be super cool to have POAP NFT treasure hunts in various cities.
advice.shipped: **Yes, by POAP and by Jamie.** Jamie ran it himself as the [612 POAP Challenge](https://www.thingelstad.com/2025/05/31/poap-challenge-collect-them-now.html) with achievement tokens (2025). POAP ran the [Airport POAP Rally 2026](https://www.thingelstad.com/2025/12/26/airport-poap-rally-website.html) as a Collection.

advice.suggestion: Organize as a DAO that people can buy into, instead of a closed VC raise
advice.words: POAP could have also formalized itself around a DAO. It could have allowed people to buy in and be part of it.
advice.shipped: No.

advice.suggestion: A way to "burn" or invalidate a farmed event
advice.words: Anti-farming for issuers would be nice. I had one POAP event get completely farmed and I would like to be able to invalidate that event somehow.
advice.shipped: Not recorded. His POAP Events list still marks Reading Things First 100 "**This event is invalid.**"

advice.suggestion: RSS feeds of claims for each event (and later each collector address)
advice.words: If every event offered an RSS feed of POAP claims, that could be used by event organizers to power a ton of automations when a token is claimed.
advice.shipped: **No, so Jamie built it.** [POAP2RSS](https://www.thingelstad.com/2025/07/06/vibe-coding-poaprss.html) launched 2025-07-04 and was submitted to the POAP Directory 2025-07-10.

advice.suggestion: Webhooks on claim
advice.words: Webhooks would be a great middle option between the full POAP API, and something simple like RSS.
advice.shipped: Not recorded.

advice.suggestion: Events signed by the issuer's wallet to prove authenticity
advice.words: It would be great to be able to sign the event with your wallet!
advice.shipped: Not recorded.

advice.suggestion: Location-bound, timeless POAPs (home, summit, cafe)
advice.words: There is an opportunity to have POAPs for things that are bound to locations instead of times.
advice.shipped: **Yes.** Location drops. Jamie's first was [2025-05-25](https://www.thingelstad.com/2025/05/25/i-created-my-very-first.html): "now you can with location drops!" ([2025-05-31](https://www.thingelstad.com/2025/05/31/poap-challenge-collect-them-now.html)).

advice.suggestion: Reminder emails and organizer visibility for email reservations
advice.words: POAP should send reminder emails to nudge those that have reserved to move forward with minting.
advice.shipped: **Yes.** [New POAP Onboarding Process](https://www.thingelstad.com/2024/01/14/new-poap-onboarding.html) (2024-01-14): reservation emails now offer actions.

advice.suggestion: A non-custodial wallet POAP creates for new users, Reddit-style, with an optional ENS name
advice.words: Better yet would be to have POAP provide a non-custodial wallet for users that don't have one.
advice.shipped: **Yes.** Privy embedded wallet with an onpoap.eth name, exportable to Rainbow (2024-01-14): "they had addressed everything I had wished for". A free ENS subname in POAP Home followed ([2024-09-24](https://www.thingelstad.com/2024/09/24/ens-continued-progress.html)).

advice.suggestion: Priority support bundled with design help ("full service")
advice.words: If bundled into a 'full service' experience I think there are companies that may pay for this.
advice.shipped: Not recorded.

advice.suggestion: Event promotion that avoids "suggested user list" problems
advice.words: POAP should avoid the problems that come from things like a 'suggested user list'.
advice.shipped: Not recorded.

advice.suggestion: One-way notifications to collectors
advice.words: One-way messaging to collectors of your POAPs would be great. For sure this would be a really big win.
advice.shipped: Not recorded.

advice.suggestion: Post-claim URL setting
advice.words: it would be sufficient for most use cases to be able to have a event setting for a URL for people to go to after claiming.
advice.shipped: Not recorded.

advice.suggestion: Opt-in drop analytics with privacy; no net-worth tracking
advice.words: these features need to all be at the wish of the issuer. I value privacy, and would want my drops to be the same way.
advice.shipped: Not recorded. POAP Family's overlap graph is the analytics Jamie used and praised ([2023-01-31](https://www.thingelstad.com/2023/01/31/poap-family.html)).

advice.suggestion: Easier claim-code management and distribution
advice.words: When I talk with people about distributing POAPs managing the claim codes is always a burden.
advice.shipped: **Partly**, per Jamie's practice. NFC IYK discs and POAP Cards made Minnebar 19 "simpler and easier to distribute" ([2025-04-06](https://www.thingelstad.com/2025/04/06/poap-planing-for-minnebar.html)). Email-only minting came with the 2024 onboarding.

advice.suggestion: Image and design services for drops
advice.words: Creating images for POAPs seems like an obvious capability.
advice.shipped: Not recorded. Jamie kept using POAPathon, then DALL-E, GPT and Gemini to make art.

advice.suggestion: Two-sided POAPs (front and back)
advice.words: Why not support two images for POAPs so they have a front and a back.
advice.shipped: Not recorded.

advice.suggestion: Official POAP Collections, with a completion POAP
advice.words: It would be cool if there was an official collection that these were part of and that was part of the event pages.
advice.shipped: **Yes.** "A year later and POAP has launched exactly what I described!" ([WT276](https://weekly.thingelstad.com/archive/276/), 2024-02-11). The Airport Rally ran as a Collection.

advice.suggestion: Unique metadata for each claim (e.g. escape-room time and clues)
advice.words: If an issuer could add one off metadata to a specific claim code it could unlock a ton of use cases.
advice.shipped: Not recorded.

advice.suggestion: POAP Collector plan at $3/mo: on-chain analytics, notes on each POAP, nearby-drop alerts, delivery alerts, one mainnet migration credit a month
advice.words: As a POAP collector, I would want to pay a relatively small monthly fee to be able to get cool information about my collection and display it well.
advice.shipped: Not recorded as a paid plan. A related free feature appears in his writing: Moments/Memories photos attached to drops ([2024-02-03](https://www.thingelstad.com/2024/02/03/i-wanted-to.html), [2025-04-28](https://www.thingelstad.com/2025/04/28/minnebar-poap.html)).

advice.suggestion: POAP Pro at $20/mo: issue by email, collections, analytics embed, external IDs, redirect, metadata per claim
advice.words: What if we just kept everything as is, but added a new POAP Pro level.
advice.shipped: Not recorded as a plan. Collections and email-based minting shipped separately (rows 8, 9, 18).

advice.suggestion: POAP Studio at $500/event and POAP for Business at $100/mo or $1,000/yr
advice.words: I think you could then have a service to provide a 'full service' experience for the issuer.
advice.shipped: Not recorded.

advice.suggestion: Free or cheap tier for non-profits
advice.words: Make it super cheap or free for non-profits to use advanced POAP Pro and Studio capabilities.
advice.shipped: Not recorded.

advice.suggestion: Bring POAPathon into the POAP drop-creation flow
advice.words: Getting in this flow of requests would help make sure there are enough contests to have a thriving community.
advice.shipped: Not recorded.

advice.suggestion: Make onboarding usable for "your average person"
advice.words: It is getting easier, but it is still ridiculously complicated for even your average person to do this.
advice.shipped: **Largely yes**, per 2024-01-14: "POAP ease-of-use is much improved!"
